propositions: Empty file_impact is ambiguous: it conflates forgotten declaration with genuinely-no-file-impact tickets, forcing conservative whole-HEAD freshness fallback and container poison rules.

An explicit tri-state file_impact_scope (undeclared, paths, none) with required no_file_impact_reason allows precise scoping: undeclared keeps conservative behavior, paths preserves current behavior, none skips invalidation on unrelated commits.
A ticket declaring file_impact_scope=none keeps its attestation valid across unrelated code changes, while undeclared tickets still invalidate on any commit.
Containers inherit only path-declaring and explicitly-none children's union, eliminating poison behavior from single undeclared children.
A plan-review criterion judges the truthfulness of explicit no-file-impact assertions, firing only when the declaration is present.
